# GitHub Copilot Instructions for did

**did** (always stylised in lowercase) is a calendar-to-timesheet web application that syncs Microsoft and Google calendar events into time entries for multi-tenant enterprise customers.

## Single source of truth

For tech stack, architecture, conventions, commands, environment setup, testing strategy, deployment workflows, and patterns to follow, read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root and the scoped `AGENTS.md` files under `client/`, `server/`, `shared/`, `docker/`, and `webpack/`.

For code-review rejection criteria (what to flag, what to block), read [`instructions/did.instructions.md`](instructions/did.instructions.md).

This file exists only because Copilot looks here by convention. Do not duplicate guidance below - update the AGENTS.md files instead.
